relationships.subject: garcinisidone E
relationships.evidence_quote: The computational outcomes show that garcinisidone E (215) and paucinervin Q (149) could be substantial candidates for CB2 receptor activation and warrant further in vivo and in vitro investigations.

relationships.subject: paucinervin Q
relationships.evidence_quote: The findings of this work reveal that 149 and 215 demonstrated the highest binding affinity to the CB2R.

key_findings: In silico screening of 235 depsidones identified garcinisidone E and paucinervin Q as top candidate CB2 agonists with stable MD complexes.
